s: Is my passion of creating handmade things, the travels and vintage vibes, the old maps, and the sensibility of all the souls that I’m connecting with on the way. Since I was a little kid I was taught that we have to respect our planet and be responsible about what and how we consume. That’s the reason why all the jackets are vintage & secondhand: there are enough clothes in the world, so we need to give them a second life to the already existing ones. That’s why every Warm Soul is different than the rest, and combined with the different pieces of map that I sew on them, every jacket is unique.
